data.define: To wear many layers because it's cold.

misuse.text: Don't tell a friend to 'bundle up' in summer.
misuse.why: It means put on warm clothes.

data.l1_hook: Ngoài trời lạnh cóng. Sẵn sàng chưa?
data.l1_ex: Bundle up đi, ngoài trời lạnh cóng!

native.tip: “bundle up” = Mặc thật ấm. Ví dụ: “Bundle up, it's freezing outside!”
native.caption:
“bundle up” nghĩa là gì?
“bundle up” = Mặc thật ấm.
Ví dụ: “Bundle up, it's freezing outside!” (Bundle up đi, ngoài trời lạnh cóng!)
